abstract: In order to elucidate the effect of hyperthermia, gestational choriocarcinoma cell line (BeWo) was studied with respect to cell growth and hormone (beta-HCG) production in various conditions of hyperthermia. BeWo was heated in the 39.0-43.0 degrees C temperature range on Day 4. The cell growth was reduced significantly at 43 degrees C for 1 hour. The same effect was observed at 39 degrees C for 120 hours. And this effect was more severe than that at 41 degrees C for 24 hours. BeWo was heated at 43 degrees C on Day 4, Day 5, and Day 6 during the logarithmic growth phase. Maximum suppression of the cell growth was observed on Day 4, and the effect was reduced with the length of time that heat application was delayed. MTX (10(-7)M) was added for 48 hours beginning on Day 4, and heat (43 degrees C for 1 hour) was applied at various points during or after MTX exposure. Heat showed an adjuvant effect with MTX when heat was applied between 24 hours after administration of MTX and 4 hours after removal of MTX. These findings strongly suggest that the heat sensitivity of BeWo is greatly related to the cell cycle. Elevated HCG production was not observed following heat alone, but observed following simultaneous heat and MTX administration. To elucidate the mechanism involved here, further studies will be needed.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、温熱の効果を明らかにするため、妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株（BeWo）について、各種温熱条件下での細胞増殖とホルモン（β-hCG）産生を検討した。対数増殖期のDay 4にBeWoを39.0〜43.0℃の温度範囲で加温した。43℃1時間の加温により細胞増殖は有意に抑制された。39℃120時間でも同様の効果が認められ、その効果は41℃24時間よりも強かった。対数増殖期のDay 4、Day 5、Day 6にそれぞれ43℃で加温したところ、細胞増殖の抑制が最大となったのはDay 4であり、加温の開始を遅らせるほど効果は減弱した。Day 4から48時間、メトトレキサート（MTX、10⁻⁷M）を投与し、MTX曝露中または曝露後の各時点で加温（43℃1時間）を行った。MTX投与の24時間後からMTX除去の4時間後までの間に加温を行った場合、加温はMTXに対する増強効果を示した。これらの所見は、BeWoの温熱感受性が細胞周期と密接に関連することを強く示唆する。加温単独ではhCG産生の上昇は認められず、加温とMTXの同時投与でhCG産生の上昇が認められた。この機序を解明するには、さらなる研究が必要である。
